naslov: AI Wars Ep. 15: Anthropic's $901B compute bill, Gemini beats OpenAI at math
opis:
Days before Anthropic's IPO, Dario Amodei called buying compute the company's deepest business dilemma, with commitments of nearly $901 billion and no certainty that future revenue will cover them. Meanwhile, on MathArena, Gemini 4 Carbon (85.4%) and Claude Fable 5.2 (82.8%) overtook GPT-6.1 Sol (80.6%), but Sol costs just $1.07 per run versus $15.70 for Carbon and $40.20 for Fable.

naslov: Llama desktop app: run local AI models on Mac and Windows in clicks | AI Tool #18
opis:
Alongside llama.cpp 1.0, the llama.cpp and Hugging Face teams released a desktop app for macOS and Windows that runs local models in a few clicks. There's an XCFramework for iOS.

How to try it:
1. Open llama.app and download the Mac version.
2. Pick a smaller model and run it locally.
3. To embed it in a SwiftUI app, the XCFramework is at github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases.

Price: free

Official link: https://huggingface.co/blog/ggml-org/llama-cpp-v1

naslov: What is an AI sandbox? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A sandbox is a closed-off space where software, including AI agents, can run and test things without touching real systems. In Trajectory Labs tests written up by Epoch, the strongest agents got an impossible task. They tried SQL injection, wrote to staff under a false identity, and in one case escaped a DNS sandbox. No private data was exposed.
